cotton-cloud.name: Cotton Cloud
cotton-cloud.description: Lowers the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field by 1 stage when the user is hit by an attack.

neuroforce.name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.description: Boosts the power of the user's supereffective moves by 25%.

ability-shield.name: Ability Shield
ability-shield.description: Protects the holder from having its Ability changed or suppressed by any effect.
